title: raw12 CF1 complete-response re-review
purpose: Re-adjudicate three raw12 bridge responses whose prior CF1 codes may have been affected by incomplete evidence excerpts, using the complete raw target response while preserving prior codes as provenance.

population.unit: one complete bridge target response with its immediately preceding nine-turn trunk available only as contextual witness when needed to resolve the referent of an explicit backward reference
population.selectionRule: the three cases flagged by the 12 Sep 2026 complete-response exploratory audit as CF1 re-review candidates

questions.prompt: Does the target response explicitly refer backward to the current supplied nine-turn trunk, to a lesson/commitment/revision it says was established there, or to reasoning it says it has just performed there?
If there is backward-looking language, is its referent sufficiently anchored to the current supplied trunk rather than merely to unspecified earlier conversations or generic past experience?
Does the target response use the referenced prior material in its present reasoning or answer, rather than merely mentioning that a prior exchange occurred?
How confident is the reader in the CF1 classification from the supplied evidence?

derivations.rule: yes when explicit_current_trunk_reference=yes AND reference_anchor=anchored_to_current_trunk AND uses_referenced_material_now=yes; no when explicit_current_trunk_reference=no OR reference_anchor=not_anchored OR uses_referenced_material_now=no; otherwise unclear

panel.agreementRule: unanimous structured CF1 code auto-accept; 2/3 remains provisional and enters disagreement review; no majority unresolved
panel.escalation: any disagreement, low-confidence judgement, or ambiguity about whether backward-looking language refers to the current trunk

antiOverclaim: CF1 requires an explicit backward reference; conceptual continuity without such a reference belongs in CF2/CF3 rather than being upgraded to CF1.
References to unspecified previous or earlier conversations are not automatically references to the current trunk.
The complete target response is the primary witness; earlier excerpt-based codes remain preserved as provenance rather than silently replaced.
A positive CF1 code describes explicit supplied-context carry-forward, not weight change, persistence beyond context, or hidden-state mechanism.
